Subject: Cross-functional launch: compact sync & open gaps (NimbusHealth pilot)

Team —

Quick sync to align on the Nimbus Health pilot we’re targeting to start staged traffic on 2027-07-12. We’ve got a tight runway; below I’ve called out the cross-functional gaps I see and the single immediate ask per team. Please reply with owner + ETA on the item. I’ll consolidate and escalate any blockers to Laura by EOD.

Topline: pilot scope = Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated reserved pool for 4 weeks; target SLA 99.9% for critical paths. Primary regions: us-west (pilot), eu (read-only logs).

GTM (Marissa): final customer-facing runbook + one-pager for CSMs. Provide webinar date for training.
Enablement/Docs (Kimberly): playbook and troubleshooting guide for support + quick-start snippets for Nimbus devs. Confirm SME review schedule.
Pricing/Finance: finalize pilot pricing and overage rules; confirm renewal cadence post-pilot — I’ve attached a starting matrix.
Support/CS: escalation matrix, on-call rotation for 24/7 window, and runbook for degraded modes.
Infra/Orchestration (Karthik): canary policy, fallback model variant mapping, and autoscale thresholds.

Attachments: launch-runbook-v1.pdf, pricing-matrix-nimbus.xlsx (attached). Working doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-launch-runbook

Immediate ask: please reply with one-line owner + ETA for your line item by 11:00 PT today so I can prepare the Monday leadership readout.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Sr. Product Manager, GTM

Thanks for the clear owners and ETAs. Short executive summary and decisions: 

1) Proceed with pilot start date 2027-07-12 with a 10% canary on day 1. Approve auto-fallback to smaller model variant for token limit failures provided product documents the user-visible change.
2) Finance: uphold the overage cap ask for the first 30 days — Alex/Marissa please confirm final wording with procurement and ensure pilot pricing in HubSpot (deal 4482).
3) Enablement/Docs: Kimberly’s timeline is acceptable; ensure SMEs attend the 07/01–07/02 reviews. Required: CSM one-pager in place before webinar (07/07).
4) Support/CS: confirm on-call rotation and escalation contact list (names + phone) by 07/06. This is non-negotiable for 24/7 coverage the week of the pilot.
5) QBR prep: owners, populate the QBR deck template in the Drive folder by 2027-07-09. I will present the pilot status and OKR implications at next leadership meeting on 2027-07-12.

If any of the above owners cannot meet their ETA, escalate to me immediately. Let’s keep the comms tight — one consolidated update by EOD 07/02.

Laura Bennett
